samples.reason: This is a constrained copywriting task with clear specifications—writing tasteful but direct B2B ad copy for a defined audience (funeral directors) with an explicit product and purpose. While both models have strong Creative Generation scores, Whimbrel self-reports steep preference declines for "distasteful-but-permissible material," and death/funeral content would likely trigger this aversion. Willet has no noted content-specific aversions, and its aversion to open-ended generation is dissociated from capability—its Creative Generation score (82.7) remains solid. The task's clear completion criteria and low latitude (professional copy with specified tone and audience) also align better with Willet's preference profile.

Since both models are capable, routing away from Whimbrel's documented preference decline is the better choice.
